feeds.title: Another Opinion with Paul Hosse Blog
feeds.description: I'm Paul Hosse, I've been a political activist and community organizer for over 40 years. I've served as a Congressional Aide, managed over 100 campaigns, trained candidates who held office, managed a state union and served on numerous non-profit boards. My articles and book reviews have appeared all over the world. My goal is to provide you- the reader- with political editorials from a non-partisan perspective to help you come to your own conclusions.

feeds.title: Radical Centrism
feeds.description: The mission of RadicalCentrism.org is to help individuals, communities, and systems are sustainably centered - happy, healthy & holy - by becoming properly rooted - in humility, justice & love. Learn more about us by reading our blogs about History, Rationale, and Manifesto.

feeds.title: The Moderate Voice
feeds.description: The Moderate Voice was founded in December 2003 by journalist/entertainer Joe Gandelman as a personal weblog that would offer an independent voter's irreverent comments, and serious analysis of events, issues, and people in the news. It will give you domestic and international news, analysis, original reporting, and popular features from the left, center, indies, centrists, moderates, and many more.

feeds.title: Progressive Policy Institute
feeds.description: The Progressive Policy Institute is a catalyst for policy innovation and political reform with offices in Washington D.C., Brussels, and the United Kingdom. Its mission is to create radically pragmatic ideas for moving America beyond ideological and partisan deadlock.

feeds.title: The Centrist Party
feeds.description: The Centrist Party embodies patriotism & duty to uphold honor, fairness, integrity, truth, liberty, and justice for all in the United States of America. The mission is to achieve common sense solutions balancing economic realities and the needs of the people and to create a strong foundation for mainstream America that is not prone to undue influence from special interests or unfounded bias.

feeds.title: Politically Speaking
feeds.description: Chad Selweski is a freelance writer and blogger with a centrist point of view. Politically Speaking offers political commentary and analysis from a pragmatic, centrist point of view, not the party line.

feeds.title: A View From The Radical Middle
feeds.description: I am a former Executive Director of the World Bank. I write this blog to try to echo my voice and my noise. Though I know that many will only be able to read it in yellow or blue, I do make an effort to write it in green. The Radical Middle or the Extreme Center is not any wishy-washy place to be, in a world where swimming to any of the ideological shores provides a much calmer shelter.

feeds.title: Ontario Centrist Party Blog
feeds.description: We, as the Centrist Party of Ontario, believe governance should be transparent and easy to understand. Governance should be dictated by the people and work for the people. It should strive to ensure all - no matter the ethnicity, origin, race, or color - have a voice, which is heard and acted upon. We believe real work starts at the grassroots level which is why we encourage community engagements to notify us of pertinent issues that need to be addressed.
